title: Change
description:
[The user currently has the "Ticket Management" screen open (object support360_ticket_assignment, type T). Resolve "this", "this form/page/screen", or "here" to this object unless they name a different one.]

Please rename the Ticket Management screen in the Manager Setup folder to Ticket Assignment.

Only the name should change. The screen’s data and settings should stay exactly the same. Also update the name anywhere else it is shown, such as the page title and any links to it.
